title: Animated geometric sigil drawing (*Intersecting Diagonal Blades* vs. *Concentric Meridian Ring*), radial particle bursts upon inscription, and a blazing harmonic laser beam connecting the 3 aligned sectors on victory.
summary: Drives stroke-drawn vector sigil animations, burst particles on inscription, and a pulsing harmonic laser across the victorious triad.
technical_specification: Store active animations in `state.world.inscriptions = []` (containing `cellIndex`, `type`, `progress: 0..1`) and `state.world.particles = []`. On `CELL_INSCRIBED`, spawn 24 radial velocity particles (`speed * cos(theta)`, damping 0.92) matching contender tint (Cyan `#00f0ff` for Blades, Gold `#ffd700` for Rings). In render loop, interpolate `progress += dt * 4`; draw Blades via `ctx.lineTo` crossed strokes and Ring via `ctx.arc(..., 0, progress * Math.PI * 2)`. If `state.stats.winVector` exists, trace a glowing laser beam through the three cell centers with outer additive glow (`ctx.shadowBlur = 18`, width 6px) and oscillating sinusoidal intensity `0.8 + 0.2 * Math.sin(time * 12)`.
acceptance_criteria: Sigils animate with continuous stroke expansion upon placement rather than appearing instantaneously.
Claiming a sector produces an immediate radial burst of 20+ particle sparks colored by faction.
Winning round draws an uninterrupted high-luminosity laser beam through the centers of all 3 winning sectors.
